The Contractor must provide qualified instructors and training program support service staff to conduct and administer all tasks required under this SOW. All instructors and training support services staff must meet the minimum personnel qualifications listed in Attachment J-2 for the applicable labor category and must obtain the appropriate FAA certifications in accordance with Attachment J-2 Appendix A, Contractor Certification Requirements.
